method: Full MP3 decode through FFmpeg 20181217-f22fcd4, EBU R128 integrated loudness/true peak; decoded 48kHz stereo float PCM, non-overlapping 10ms RMS blocks below -50dBFS for low-level edges. Edge sums are near-silence estimates, not musical seamlessness ratings.
limitations: No auditory judgement of musical continuity or theme suitability
No Unity playback, map switching, looping or gameplay SFX balance verification: selected BGM is not integrated
